method: Decode locked source bytes to RGB; compute grayscale spatial gradient magnitude; sample 1440 angular positions on concentric radii from 5 to 169.5 px at 0.5 px increments; aggregate circular edge response. This pass measures radial evidence only and does not segment cells.

strongRadialResponsesPx.interpretation: nearby boundary response; may belong to same boundary family

conclusion.reason: Radial evidence supports multiple structural scales but does not by itself establish independent closed cells or 3/7/12 cardinalities.

next: Perform closed-region/cell segmentation inside the central ROI, retain stable regions across threshold/scale sweeps, then infer adjacency and layers before H-22 comparison.
